title: Fix DOM XSS vulnerability in MathJax rendering
description: User input from the textarea is inserted into the DOM using `node.innerHTML` in `UpdateMath`. This allows DOM-based Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) if a user enters HTML payloads (e.g., ``), which could be weaponized via the URL hash. Replace `innerHTML` with `textContent` or properly escape the input before insertion.
notes: Fixed DOM XSS vulnerability in public_html/main.js by using `textContent` instead of `innerHTML` in `UpdateMath`, and `.text()` instead of `.html()` for jQuery updates. Verified fix through newly added unit test ensuring raw tags are safely set as text.

title: Fix cross-origin exception when accessing parent.location.hash
description: The script accesses and modifies `parent.location.hash`. If the application is ever embedded in an iframe on a different domain, accessing `parent.location` properties will throw a `SecurityError` (DOMException) due to the Same-Origin Policy, breaking the application. Use `window.location.hash` or wrap the access in a try-catch block.
notes: Fixed the cross-origin exception issue when accessing parent.location.hash by wrapping the accesses in a try-catch block and falling back to window.location.hash in case of SecurityError DOMExceptions. This allows the application to function correctly even when embedded inside a cross-origin iframe.

title: Add GitHub Actions workflow for Pages
description: Create a workflow file in .github/workflows to deploy public_html to GitHub Pages
notes: Implemented the deploy-pages.yml workflow using standard GitHub Pages setup. I've separated it into 'build' and 'deploy' jobs. The 'build' job checks out the repo, sets up Node.js 20, runs 'npm ci' and 'npm test' to verify tests pass, configures pages, and uploads the 'public_html' directory as the artifact. The 'deploy' job waits for 'build' and then uses 'deploy-pages@v4' to actually deploy to GitHub Pages. The YAML syntax has been verified.

title: Insert pre-made symbols at cursor position instead of textarea end
description: When a user clicks a pre-made symbol (e.g., from the Math/Symbols/Greek tabs), the symbol is appended to the very end of the textarea via `$maths.val($maths.val() + $str)`. If the user is editing a long formula, they expect the symbol to be inserted at their current cursor position/selection.
notes: Modified main.js to use selectionStart and selectionEnd of the textarea to insert the pre-made symbol at the cursor position. Focused the textarea after insertion.

title: Provide visual feedback when 'Save page' is clicked
description: Clicking the 'Save page' link updates the URL hash but provides no visual feedback to the user (e.g., 'URL updated!' or 'Copied to clipboard'). Users might click it multiple times thinking it didn't work.
notes: Updated the #save-page click handler to display 'Saved!' and revert to the original text after 2 seconds using setTimeout.
